title: Canonical Suitability Model (CSM) v1.0
description: Template-agnostic canonical model for facts asserted by, or extractable from, an advice case. Populated by an LLM from a suitability report/letter (category I) and, using the same shapes, from supporting evidence (categories A-H) so that QA checks CHK-001..CHK-010 reduce to field-level comparisons between two instances of this model. Field names and enumerations are aligned to Intelliflo Office (consolidated-swagger.json) resources wherever an equivalent resource exists.

dependants.description: Every stated child or dependant, including grandchildren where named separately. A statement that children are financially independent is a claim with isFinanciallyDependant false, not an absence — it is checkable and must be recorded as such. Material to death benefits, IHT and affordability.

objectives.description: Demands and needs / goals. CHK-002 primary payload.

existingArrangements.description: Existing plans/policies described in the report. CHK-001/003/007/009.

recommendations.description: One entry per discrete recommended action. CHK-006 primary payload.

replacementAnalysis.description: One entry per plan being replaced/switched/transferred. CHK-009 trigger and payload.

Provenance.description: Attach to every extracted entity or statement. This is what makes the model auditable: a QA finding must be able to cite where in the document the asserted fact came from.

assertionStatus.description: Stated = explicit in the document. Inferred = the LLM concluded it from narrative prose. Derived = calculated from other extracted values. Absent = the model expected it and could not find it. One of: Stated, Inferred, Derived, Absent.

modality.description: What KIND of claim this is, which is a different question from assertionStatus and is answered independently of it. assertionStatus says how we came to know the value; modality says what the document is asserting about it. Both a current salary and a retirement income projected thirty years out can be Stated, and comparing them as though they were the same claim is how a projection comes to be reported as a discrepancy against a fact find. Actual = true at the date of the report. Reported = the client said so. Intended = the client plans it. Assumed = an adviser or modelling assumption. Projected = a future value from an illustration or cashflow. Recommended = part of the advice rather than the current position. Conditional = only holds if a stated condition applies, including a charge phrased as "if you were to retain the plan". Unknown = the document does not make it determinable. Where the report gives no signal, Reported is the usual reading for a client circumstance and Actual for a figure the report states as current fact. One of: Actual, Reported, Intended, Assumed, Projected, Recommended, Conditional, Unknown.

documentId.description: Identifier of the source document within the case bundle.

quote.description: Verbatim supporting text, trimmed. Required whenever assertionStatus is Stated or Inferred.

extractionNote.description: Why the LLM read the text this way; ambiguity flags.

Evidenced.description: Mixin applied to entities: 'provenance' documents where the entity came from.

basis.description: What the percentage is of, e.g. 'of fund value pa'.

Frequency.description: Intelliflo Office frequency enum plus OneOff/Unspecified. One of: Monthly, Weekly, Fortnightly, FourWeekly, Quarterly, HalfYearly, Annually, OneOff, Unspecified.

DocumentCategory.description: Quality-check document taxonomy (Document Categories v1). One of: A_ClientAuthority, B_KnowYourClient, C_MeetingsAndCommunications, D_RiskCapacityAndExperience, E_ExistingPlansAndPortfolios, F_NeedsAnalysis, G_Research, H_SolutionDesign, I_RecommendationsAndAdvice.

Statement.description: A narrative assertion the report makes that a check must test for presence, specificity and consistency (rationale bullets, risk warnings, disadvantages, explanations).

isClientSpecific.description: False where the wording is generic boilerplate. Direct input to CHK-006 personalisation and CHK-008 prominence.

SourceDescriptor.description: What was parsed to produce this instance.

documentType.description: One of: SuitabilityReport, ReviewReport, FactFind, FileNote, RiskProfileReport, PolicyInformation, Illustration, ResearchReport, CashflowOutput, ClientAgreement, KeyFeatures, FundFactsheet, Other.

items.description: One of: PensionAccumulation, PensionDecumulation, PensionSwitch, PensionTransferDB, Investment, ISA, Protection, Mortgage, EquityRelease, EstatePlanning, Retirement, Other.

adviceBasis.description: One of: Independent, RestrictedWholeOfMarket, Restricted, Unspecified.

serviceType.description: One of: Advised, InformationOnly, Execution, Unspecified.

___SECTION_PARTIES___.description: Category A/B: who the client is

Client.description: Aligned to Intelliflo Office Client + PersonValue.

clientId.description: Local id used for cross-references within this instance.

role.description: One of: Primary, Joint, Third, Beneficiary, Other.

firstName.description: Exactly as spelled in the report. Do not normalise a spelling and do not merge two differently-named people into one identity even where the context implies they are the same person: identities disagreeing across documents is a review signal, and normalising it here is what makes it invisible later.

age.description: The age the report states, per person. Never derive it from a date of birth or back out of a retirement horizon: a derived age agreeing with the fact find proves nothing, and a stated age disagreeing with one is the finding.

maritalStatus.description: The stated legal status. Do not infer it from joint finances alone. Where the report states a legal status and a living arrangement together — recently divorced, living with a partner — the legal status is this value and the cohabitation belongs in the surrounding fields, not folded into it.

clientCategory.description: One of: Retail, Professional, EligibleCounterparty, Consumer.

taxStatus.description: CHK-001 essential facts; CHK-008 tax consequences.

incomeTaxBand.description: One of: NonTaxpayer, Starter, Basic, Intermediate, Higher, AdvancedScottish, Additional, Top, Unknown.

hasWill.description: Whether a valid will is stated to be in place. 'You have confirmed you have a valid Will' is a true value with provenance modality Reported. An accompanying acknowledgement that it needs updating qualifies the assertion and must survive — set isWillUpToDate rather than losing it.

isPowerOfAttorneyGranted.description: Whether a Power of Attorney is stated to be registered, with its coverage preserved in the surrounding fields. A stated intention to appoint one is provenance modality Intended. An adviser recommending the client set one up is a recommendation, not this field — and where both appear, both must be recorded, because together they say the attorney is not yet in place.

pensionSharingOrders.description: Awards of a share of an ex-spouse's pension under a divorce settlement. Held separately from taxStatus.protections, which is Lifetime Allowance protection and a different thing: a pension credit is an asset the client has been awarded, evidenced by the court order, while a protection is a tax status. The awarded value is usually approximate until the receiving scheme confirms it, so the report's figure and the order's figure differ legitimately and the check is that both were stated, not that they match to the penny.

employments.description: One entry per employment claim, and deliberately 'many': current status, a recently ceased role and a planned change coexist here without being reconciled. A planned change to working patterns — reducing hours, stopping from a future date — is its own entry with provenance modality Intended, never an edit to the current one.

PensionSharingOrder.description: A share of an ex-spouse's pension awarded under a divorce settlement (a pension credit). The receiving-plan recommendation is a Recommendation; this is the award itself, and it is evidenced by the court order or the ceding provider's correspondence rather than by the suitability report restating it.

cedingProvider.description: The scheme the credit comes from.

isValueEstimated.description: True where the report states the figure as approximate or subject to confirmation. Set this rather than rounding the figure: an estimate presented as settled is the misstatement worth catching.

implementationStatus.description: One of: Awarded, Pending, Implemented, Unknown.

employmentStatus.description: One of: Unknown, SelfEmployed, CompanyDirector, Retired, Unemployed, Houseperson, Student, MaternityLeave, LongTermIllness, ContractWorker, Employed, CarerOfaChildUnder16, CarerOfaPersonOver16, Other.

StatePensionEntitlement.description: Called out separately because CHK-001 and CHK-005 name state pension entitlement explicitly.

relationshipType.description: One of: Child, Daughter, Grandchild, Grandparent, Parent, Son, Spouse, StepChild, Partner, CivilPartner, StepParent, Other.

type.description: One of: Accountant, Solicitor, Attorney, Trustee, Employer, Other.

ClientAuthority.description: Category A. CHK-001 and CHK-010 reference client authority documents; the report typically only asserts that they exist and what was agreed.

feeAgreementBasis.description: How remuneration was agreed, e.g. 'facilitated from the plan'.

incomes.description: One entry per stated income: earner, source, amount, frequency, and whether net. Preserve the period exactly — 'every four weeks' is not 'per month'. A State Pension payable from a future age, or expected future self-employment earnings, is provenance modality Projected; an income stated as in payment now is Actual or Reported. This is the one fact the SR-internal consistency check reconciles, so a projection recorded as a current figure produces a contradiction that does not exist. An income that has ceased or will cease is still an entry, with the cessation recorded.

expenditures.description: Deliberately 'many': the same report states expenditure for now, for retirement and as a modelling input, and each is separately checkable. Extract each with its stated period and keep essential, discretionary and one-off components apart. A cashflow input is an entry with provenance modality Assumed even where it differs from the stated current figure. Do not reconcile differing statements — the difference is the point.

assets.description: Each stated property or significant physical asset with its value and, for property, its mortgage status. 'Mortgage-free' is a claim about the absence of secured debt and needs evidence like any negative assertion. Do not copy full addresses in — the property is identified by its role. Nil-rate-band and allowance explanations are background, not assets.

liabilities.description: Each stated debt with its outstanding amount, repayment and remaining term — repayment detail often appears only as a cashflow input, and counts. A statement of 'no outstanding liabilities' is a false-valued claim to be recorded, not an empty array.

emergencyFund.description: Aligned to Intelliflo Office EmergencyFund. CHK-005 explicitly tests emergency fund and liquidity.

liquidityAndAccessNeeds.description: Emergency, planned and ad-hoc access requirements named by CHK-002 and CHK-005.

accessType.description: One of: Emergency, Planned, AdHoc, Regular, Unspecified.

foreseeableChanges.description: Foreseeable life changes named by CHK-002 (retirement, inheritance, care costs, income cessation).

category.description: One of: Employment, SelfEmployment, StatePension, PrivatePension, Investment, Rental, Benefits, Trust, Other.

isConsolidated.description: True where the report gives one combined household figure rather than itemised lines.

AssetItem.description: Aligned to Intelliflo Office Asset. Non-plan assets only; plans belong in existingArrangements.

assetType.description: One of: Cash, Collectibles, HolidayHome, HomeContents, InvestmentProperty, MainResidence, MotorVehicles, OverseasProperty, OwnBusiness, RentalOrOtherProperty, SecondHome, Investments, BuyToLetProperty, CommercialProperty, Other.

liabilityType.description: One of: Mortgage, SecondCharge, PersonalLoan, CreditCard, CarFinance, StudentLoan, Overdraft, Other.

___SECTION_OBJECTIVES___.description: Category B/F: goals, demands and needs

Objective.description: Aligned to Intelliflo Office BaseObjective + typed objective subclasses. CHK-002 tests these against recommendations; CHK-006 requires each recommendation to link back to one.

objectiveType.description: One of: Pension, Investment, Protection, Mortgage, EstatePlanning, Budget, EquityRelease, Other. Guidance, not a constraint: an enum here would be enforced by CanonicalModelValidator.StripEnumViolations, which deletes values it does not recognise. Extraction has been observed writing RetirementObjective for this field, and stripping that would leave the objective untyped and silently take CHK-002 and CHK-003 out of the run. The vocabulary is enforced where a mismatch is harmless instead — in each plan's triggerProbe.applicability, where an unrecognised value means the check does not apply rather than the data disappearing.

summary.description: One objective per entry, in wording close to the report's own. Negative preferences — an explicit wish NOT to move or invest particular funds — are objectives too, and the negation must survive.

isClientStated.description: False where the objective appears to be adviser-generated rather than client-expressed.

targetAge.description: The age the client states an intention to retire at. Do not put a modelling assumption here as though it were an intention: where the report frames the age as a planning input, provenance modality is Assumed, and where the client asked for it, Intended or Reported.

timeHorizon.description: One of: None, ShortTerm, MediumTerm, LongTerm.

needLevelRisk.description: Risk required to meet this specific need, where the report states it separately from overall ATR (CHK-003).

___SECTION_RISK___.description: Category D: risk, capacity and experience

RiskAssessment.description: CHK-003 payload. Modelled per client because joint cases can differ.

AttitudeToRisk.description: Aligned to Intelliflo Office AtrChosenRiskProfile / AtrGeneratedRiskProfile.

CapacityForLoss.description: The concluded capacity to absorb loss, kept separate from attitude to risk. A composite label such as 'Medium-High' is its own level and is never rounded to an adjacent one — put it verbatim in ratingRaw and map only where the mapping is exact ('Moderate' is medium). A statement that underperformance would not affect day-to-day living is the basis for the level, recorded in assessmentBasis; it is not the level itself.

rating.description: One of: None, Low, Medium, High, Unspecified.

assessmentBasis.description: The facts the report relies on: surplus income, other assets, no liabilities, alternative provision.

isSeparatelyAssessedFromAtr.description: False where CFL is asserted only as a restatement of ATR - a common CHK-003 concern.

RiskReconciliation.description: Where the agreed risk level differs from the questionnaire result, CHK-003 requires the override and its justification to be explicit and evidenced.

statedLevel.description: One of: None, Limited, Moderate, Good, Extensive, Unspecified.

understandingEvidence.description: Client questions, explanations given and comprehension confirmations - CHK-004 asks for evidence the client can evaluate risks and features.

recommendedProductComplexity.description: Complexity classification of each recommended product, to be compared against statedLevel.

VulnerabilityAssessment.description: CHK-010 payload, aligned to Intelliflo Office ClientVulnerabilityDocument. Applies as an overlay to every other check.

hasVulnerability.description: One of: Yes, No, Possible, NotAssessed.

items.description: One of: Health, LifeEvents, Resilience, Capability, Unspecified.

authorityType.description: One of: LPA, Deputy, Consent, Informal, Other.

foreseeableHarms.description: PRIN 2A consumer duty overlay - harms identified and how mitigated.

___SECTION_EXISTING___.description: Category E: existing plans and portfolios

ExistingArrangement.description: Aligned to Intelliflo Office BasePlan + PensionContributionDrawdownPlan + PlanValuation + PlanCharge + GetPlanHolding.

planType.description: One of: PersonalPension, StakeholderPension, SIPP, OccupationalDC, OccupationalDB, SectionS32, AVC, GPP, Drawdown, Annuity, ISA, GIA, OEIC, InvestmentBondOnshore, InvestmentBondOffshore, VCT, EIS, CashAccount, Protection, Mortgage, Other.

contributions.description: Each statement about contributions to this arrangement, including the negative ones: 'none ongoing', 'Nil', 'paid up', 'dormant', or no contributions in a stated tax year. Those are claims requiring evidence, not absences. A plan that WILL become paid up is a claim about future status. Advice to start or change a contribution is a recommendation, not this.

holdings.description: Each currently held fund with its allocation, as a percentage or an amount — whichever the report states. Record a stated combined portfolio risk level and any stated per-fund levels separately and never reconcile them: a combined level disagreeing with its constituents is exactly what verification exists to surface. Distinct from the recommended funds under solution.investmentStrategy.

isComparableToClientScale.description: Critical for CHK-003: provider risk scales are not interchangeable.

exitPenalties.description: Per-arrangement penalties for transferring or switching out. 'No charges for transfer' is a false-valued claim requiring evidence, not an omission.

items.description: One of: FlexiAccessDrawdown, UFPLS, PartialUFPLS, Annuity, SmallPots, Triviality, PCLSOnly, Other.

performance.description: Each stated historical figure with its instrument, period, as-at date and data source, preserving whether it is cumulative or annualised — never convert between them, because the same strategy is quoted both ways and each must stay independently checkable. Stated volatility, with-profits guaranteed growth and bonus rates, and a cash account's current interest rate all belong here. A comparative judgement — 'has not performed as well as' — is not a figure; extract the figures it rests on. Past-performance risk warnings are not claims.

otherFeatures.description: Per-arrangement capability assertions checkable against provider literature: which retirement options exist, how many funds are available, whether a servicing adviser may be added. A stated UNAVAILABLE capability — 'flexi-access drawdown is not available', 'allows servicing adviser: No' — is a false-valued claim like any other negative assertion. Generic education about what drawdown is creates no claim.

adviceAction.description: The recommended treatment of this arrangement. Triggers CHK-009 when Switch/Transfer/Encash/Surrender. One of: Retain, RetainAndSwitchFunds, PartialTransfer, FullTransfer, Switch, Encash, Surrender, Stop, Amend, NoAdviceGiven.

SafeguardedBenefits.description: CHK-009 explicitly requires lost features/guarantees to be identified.

items.description: One of: GuaranteedAnnuityRate, GuaranteedMinimumPension, GuaranteedGrowthRate, EnhancedTaxFreeCash, ProtectedRetirementAge, ProtectedPCLS, WithProfitsBonus, MarketValueReductionFree, LifeCover, WaiverOfPremium, Other.

contributionType.description: One of: Regular, LumpSum, Transfer, Rebate.

payer.description: One of: Client, Employer, ThirdParty, Unspecified.

withdrawalType.description: One of: Regular, LumpSum, PercentageOfInvestment, PercentageOfFund, Transfer, PCLS, UFPLS.

Holding.description: Aligned to Intelliflo Office GetPlanHolding + Fund.

PerformanceLine.description: CHK-007 value assessment and CHK-009 comparison evidence.

role.description: One of: Existing, Recommended, Benchmark, PeerGroup, Other.

NeedsAnalysis.description: CHK-002 and CHK-005 draw on cashflow and shortfall modelling.

scenarioType.description: One of: Baseline, Proposed, StressTest, Alternative.

stressType.description: One of: HighInflation, MarketCrash, Longevity, EarlyDeath, IncomeLoss, CareCosts, InterestRate, Combined, Other.

scenarios.description: Each modelling or stress-test outcome with its scenario and whether a shortfall is projected. Survivor scenarios and life-expectancy adequacy statements are scenarios too. The numeric inputs behind them are incomes, expenditures and assumptions, not this.

assumptions.description: Each stated modelling assumption as its own entry: the parameter and its rate or treatment. Prefer provenance modality Assumed where the report frames it as a modelling input, even when it is phrased in projection language. Where an assumption conflicts with a fact stated elsewhere — modelled expenditure against stated expenditure, a modelled retirement age against a stated intention — both must exist, or the difference cannot be found.

Research.description: Category G facts asserted inside the report. Used by CHK-006 (alternatives), CHK-007 (cost comparison) and CHK-009 (switch analysis).

optionsConsidered.description: The option set the adviser says was evaluated (e.g. 'leave untouched', 'switch funds in situ', 'new plan').

optionType.description: One of: DoNothing, InSituFundSwitch, ConsolidateIntoExisting, EmployerScheme, NewPlan, AlternativeProduct, AlternativeProvider, AlternativeWrapper, AlternativeStrategy, InvestmentPathway, Other.

dimension.description: One of: Cost, Performance, Volatility, FundRange, Flexibility, Service, FinancialStrength, Features, Other.

RecommendationImplementation.description: Who will carry out a recommended change, and when. CHK-006 requires a report suggesting a change to say whether the adviser will arrange it.

willAdviserImplement.description: Null where the report does not say, which is itself the CHK-006 finding.

responsibleParty.description: Who acts. One of: Adviser, Firm, Client, Provider, ThirdParty, NotStated.

expectedTimescale.description: When, as the report states it. Material to suitability where the client is out of the market or working to a deadline.

PresentedOption.description: One outcome the report puts to the client. Where several are presented and none is recommended, CHK-006 treats the recommendation as unresolved.

reasonGiven.description: Why this option was recommended or set aside. Absent where the report leaves the choice open without explaining it.

Recommendation.description: Aligned to Intelliflo Office Recommendation2Document + BaseRecommendation2Proposal. proposalType reuses the IO proposal discriminator so a recommendation can be pushed into Office as a proposal.

proposalType.description: One of: NewBusinessPensionProposal, NewBusinessInvestmentProposal, NewBusinessAnnuityProposal, NewBusinessPersonalProtectionProposal, NewBusinessMortgageProposal, NewBusinessEquityReleaseProposal, NewBusinessGeneralInsuranceProposal, ExistingBusinessTransferRolloverProposal, ExistingBusinessSwitchProposal, ExistingBusinessRebalanceProposal, ExistingBusinessNewMoneyProposal, ExistingBusinessLumpsumWithdrawalProposal, ExistingBusinessAmendRegularContributionsPremiumsProposal, ExistingBusinessAmendRegularWithdrawalIncomeProposal, ExistingBusinessAmendProductDetailsProposal, ExistingBusinessCloseProductProposal, ExistingBusinessNoActionProposal, ExistingBusinessReviewedProposal, NonProductProposal.

action.description: One of: NewPlan, Transfer, Switch, Consolidate, Retain, Encash, Surrender, Rebalance, IncreaseContribution, DecreaseContribution, StartWithdrawal, AmendWithdrawal, Crystallise, NonProductAction, Other.

linkedObjectiveIds.description: CHK-006 requires each recommendation to tie to a stated objective.

adviceStatus.description: Whether the report actually recommends this change, or only raises it. CHK-006 requires the report to say which, and "you may wish to consider" is not a recommendation. Distinct from action, which says what the change is rather than whether it is advised. One of: Recommended, Suggested, ClientInstructed, InformationOnly, NotStated.

intendedOutcome.description: What the change is meant to achieve for the client, as the report states it. Separate from rationale: the rationale argues why the recommendation is suitable, the intended outcome is what it is expected to produce. CHK-006 requires both.

implementation.description: Who acts, and when. solution.implementation carries this for the case as a whole; CHK-006 asks it of each change.

optionsPresented.description: Where the report offers the client a choice rather than a recommendation. CHK-006 flags any recommendation presenting several possible outcomes without naming one and saying why.

presentsUnresolvedOptions.description: True where optionsPresented holds more than one option and none is marked isRecommended. Derived, and stated so the finding does not depend on re-deriving it.

rationale.description: Why this is suitable, in client-specific terms.

clientAgreementStatements.description: Where the report records that the client understood or agreed.

alternativeType.description: One of: DoNothing, AlternativeProduct, AlternativeProvider, AlternativeWrapper, AlternativeInvestmentStrategy, StakeholderPension, InvestmentPathway, EmployerScheme, InSituSwitch, Other.

AlternativeQuote.description: The figures behind an alternative that was actually quoted rather than merely named — in practice an annuity quotation, or a comparable-annuity income in a sustainability table. Separate from comparativeCost because that is one amount and this is a claim about a product: an income per annum, on a term basis, from a named provider. Without it a report stating that an annuity would pay a given income asserts a checkable number that no check can reach.

termBasis.description: One of: Lifetime, FixedTerm, UntilStatePensionAge, Other.

paymentFrequency.description: One of: Monthly, Quarterly, HalfYearly, Annually, Other.

financialStrengthRating.description: Only specific, checkable assertions: a credit rating with its agency, assets under management with an as-at date, or a status such as 'closed to new business' — which is often what a transfer is justified by. Generic marketing (award-winning, innovative, strong governance) is not a claim and does not belong here.

items.description: One of: Illustration, KeyFeatures, KID, KIID, TermsAndConditions, FundFactsheets, ClientAgreement, ChargesSchedule, CancellationNotice, Other.

RecommendedPlan.description: Aligned to Intelliflo Office BasePlan for the proposed product.

wrapper.description: One of: PersonalPension, SIPP, ISA, GIA, Bond, Drawdown, Annuity, Other.

plannedWithdrawals.description: Each recommended withdrawal per person: method, amount and frequency, the stated tax-free and taxable split, when it starts and the event that ends it. The split, and any assertion that the taxable element falls within the Personal Allowance, are arithmetic a check will redo — extract the figures verbatim. A statement that NO withdrawal is required is a negative claim under this field. A stated consequence, such as triggering the MPAA, is part of the claim.

projections.description: Each projected value at a stated age under a stated growth scenario, noting real terms where stated, for both the existing and the recommended plan. Extract every figure verbatim: identical projected values for the old and new plans alongside a stated charge difference is precisely the inconsistency verification has to see, and it disappears the moment a figure is tidied.

InvestmentStrategy.description: Aligned to Intelliflo Office PortfolioModel / ProposedFundValue. CHK-003 compares this to the risk profile.

strategyType.description: One of: ModelPortfolio, MultiAssetFund, BespokePortfolio, DFM, InvestmentPathway, SingleFund, Other.

holdings.description: Each recommended fund with its allocation, stated risk rating and charge — all three checkable, against fund documentation and against the client's agreed risk rating. Distinct from the arrangement's current holdings.

CostsAndCharges.description: Aligned to Intelliflo Office PlanCharge / PlanFee / FeeType / FundCharges. Structured so that aggregation completeness (all material cost layers disclosed) is machine-testable.

adviserFees.description: Each fee as its own entry: initial or ongoing, percentage, monetary estimate, and whether it is paid from the plan or directly. Where the report states the basis — a percentage of a listed set of values, payment from a particular wrapper — preserve it; the basis is what the client agreement is checked against.

basis.description: One of: LikeForLike, IncludingAdviceFees, ExcludingAdviceFees, Other.

reductionInYield.description: Each stated critical yield with its growth-rate basis and horizon age, also phrased as the 'rate of return required'. Appendix tables state one per growth scenario per person: each scenario is its own entry, with its reduction in yield, headroom and effect of switching. A sustainability critical yield — the growth a drawdown fund needs to match a comparable annuity — belongs here too. An assertion that the yield is achievable is context, not the yield.

valueAssessment.description: PRIN 2A.4 fair value. CHK-007 asks whether benefits justify cost.

disclosureCompleteness.description: Presence flags per cost layer - directly answers the CHK-007 'all material costs disclosed' test.

ChargeSet.description: Layered cost breakdown for one arrangement or for the proposed solution.

layer.description: One of: Product, Platform, InvestmentManagement, Fund, TransactionCost, DFM, AdviceInitial, AdviceOngoing, AdviceAdHoc, Administration, ExitPenalty, Other.

chargeType.description: Intelliflo Office PlanCharge.type. One of: OneOffCharge, OngoingCharge, TransactionCost, IncidentalCost.

feeChargingType.description: One of: FixedPrice, PercentOfFumAum, PercentOfAllInvestmentContribution, PercentOfLumpSumContribution, PercentOfTransferContribution, PercentOfRegularContribution, TieredPercentOfAum, NonChargeable, Other.

matchesClientAgreement.description: Comparison against category A evidence; null when not determinable from this document alone.

ReplacementAnalysis.description: One per ceding arrangement. Everything CHK-009 asks for is a named field so absence is detectable rather than inferred from prose.

replacementType.description: One of: PensionSwitch, PensionTransferDB, InvestmentReRegistration, BondSurrender, IsaTransfer, Encashment, Other.

comparison.description: Existing vs recommended on each dimension.

dimension.description: One of: Charges, FundRange, Performance, RiskAlignment, RetirementOptions, Flexibility, AdviserServicing, DeathBenefits, Guarantees, Service, Other.

assessment.description: One of: Better, Worse, Equivalent, NotAssessed.

costsOfSwitching.description: The stated cost comparison, with its basis: like-for-like, including adviser fees, or per scheme. Component comparisons (platform only, funds only) are separate from total-cost ones — record which the basis covers. Preserve sign and direction exactly: a new plan dearer once fees are included is a materially different claim from a like-for-like saving, and they routinely appear in the same report.

prominence.description: COBS 4.2.1R fair, clear and not misleading; disadvantages must not be buried.

allowanceType.description: One of: AnnualAllowance, MPAA, CarryForward, LumpSumAllowance, LumpSumAndDeathBenefitAllowance, ISA, CGT, DividendAllowance, PersonalAllowance, NilRateBand, ResidenceNilRateBand, Other.

CheckTriggers.description: Derived booleans that tell the QA engine which checks are in scope, so 'N/A: trigger absent' is a computed outcome rather than an LLM judgement.

ExtractionReport.description: Self-assessment of the extraction pass. Distinguishes 'the report does not say this' from 'the extractor could not find it' - the two produce very different QA outcomes.

expectedButAbsent.description: Canonical paths the model expected for this case type and did not find. Feeds completeness scoring for CHK-006/007/008/009.

reason.description: One of: NotPresentInDocument, PresentButUnparseable, AmbiguousReference, OutOfScopeForCaseType.

internalInconsistencies.description: Contradictions found within this single document - these are findable without any other evidence and are high-value CHK-001 hits.
